## Completed implementation and setup — no R01 execution

Pushed to `main`: v5 setup tooling `9c799de1b5cfff16082e65531933e7a249544282` and retained completion/baseline record `e4ec8024fa6a954dda062677ea3d325b8ebd5cbd`.

- Corrected P5 v5 freeze: `52eb3569b3671baa37426792a67b50058e2d223f`; exact `GATEWAY_BASE_URL=https://cliproxy.local.faviann.com/v1`.
- Compatible product/dependency/test baseline: `9c799de1b5cfff16082e65531933e7a249544282`. Product/dependency bytes match the corrected freeze. All 15 installed SDK files, including the native executable, match the pinned 10.3.0.post1 wheel; Zeroshot remains 10.3.0.
- Full suite: **351 tests and 267 subtests passed**, zero failures/skips. [Retained identities, test output and checksummed evidence](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/e4ec8024fa6a954dda062677ea3d325b8ebd5cbd/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-19-v5-setup/README.md).
- [Tracked v5 setup helper and handoff](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/e4ec8024fa6a954dda062677ea3d325b8ebd5cbd/evaluation/p5/v5/setup.md) prepare the frozen fixture and read existing GitHub inputs without admission, target/provider execution or remote mutation. Actual setup was repeated identically for private `faviann/broodling-p5-v3-20260917`, unchanged R01 issue #1 and `p5-eval` at exact B1.
- Fresh durable v5 source/store/Contract records exist. The store has zero admission decisions, Attempts, worktree assignments, submissions, results or dispositions. R01–R08 remain NOT_STARTED. Historical v1-v4/evidence and the corrected v5 protocol are unchanged.

Implementation/setup obligations are complete. Before #79: separately authorize and supervise the one R01; supply exact gateway URL, current nonempty gateway key and current authorized GitHub delivery credential; start a compatible isolated DirectTarget (the previous container is stopped); check discovery/empty inventory, target gateway connectivity and stop/quarantine capacity; recheck baseline/fixture/zero-start state and use a new live-evidence directory. Do not use the obsolete v4 driver. No successful native-PR boundary, task-quality result or P5 readiness is claimed; #68 remains gated.

---

## Outcome

Make Broodling's fixed V1 authorized-PR profile use Zeroshot's supported Codex `gateway` provider through CLIProxyAPI at exactly `https://cliproxy.local.faviann.com/v1`. Supply `GATEWAY_BASE_URL` and `GATEWAY_API_KEY` ephemerally at dispatch instead of `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

This is the smallest prerequisite alignment before any P5 live-boundary work. Do not admit or run R01 in this issue.

## Authority and dependency finding

Follow #62, #72, #79, current `main`, and `docs/governing/current.md`. The pinned Zeroshot 10.3.0 source is authoritative for the provider seam: `codex/gateway` is supported, its uniform-runtime connection requires exactly `GATEWAY_BASE_URL` and `GATEWAY_API_KEY`, and Codex uses the gateway's Responses API. Zeroshot rejects conflicting OpenAI/Codex/OpenRouter/Bedrock provider credentials on this lane.

This does not reopen #72's node-local OAuth question. Keep the supported named `DirectTarget` topology and its explicit source/delivery authority.

## Exact implementation scope

- Change only the fixed V1 pull-request runtime provider from `openai` to `gateway`.
- Keep the Codex harness, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium reasoning effort, size `small`, execution-scoped sessions, and one `UniformRuntime` across every executable `software-change` node.
- Keep Zeroshot's standard `software-change` workflow and native `pull_request` delivery through `DirectTarget`.
- Keep the Contract-authorized GitHub repository, target branch, exact B1 revision, submission key/idempotent replay, durable run correlation, native receipt/head-revision validation, current-Attempt checks, and disposition/quarantine rules unchanged.
- Replace the current PR provider credential input/handoff with a current nonempty `GATEWAY_API_KEY` and the exact `GATEWAY_BASE_URL=https://cliproxy.local.faviann.com/v1`. Pass those values, together with the current GitHub delivery credential, only in the SDK environment for a new or idempotently replayed dispatch. Do not send `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- Keep all credential values out of Contracts, persisted requests/runtime plans, logs, evidence, and reconnect/wait/stop clients. Preserve credential-free reconnection from the persisted `DirectTarget` origin.
- Fail closed before dispatch or replay when either gateway field is missing/empty, the base URL differs from the selected endpoint, or a conflicting legacy provider credential would reach the gateway runtime.
- Update focused policy/submission/crash-recovery tests and current product/integration documentation for the new fixed provider binding. Do not introduce caller-selectable providers, per-node overrides, a connection store, a proxy client, or custom delivery machinery.

## P5 preservation and ordering

Preserve every existing P5 evidence package and protocol version v1-v4 byte-for-byte, including all BLOCKED/NOT RUN provenance, the frozen corpus and judge, v2 claim-level rules, and v3 operational policy.

Because `p5-native-pr-v4` froze the OpenAI/`OPENAI_API_KEY` lane, record only the provider/credential delta as the smallest prospective P5 profile successor; do not rewrite v4 or rescore prior evidence. Align the current #62/#79 dependency text before any later live work. R01-R08 remain `NOT_STARTED`; the R01 slot is not consumed by implementation, tests, documentation, setup, or endpoint preflight.

Do not run #79 as its current OpenAI/v4 wording directs. After this issue lands and the successor freeze/baseline identities are recorded, separately authorize the one R01 live-boundary execution against the gateway profile. #68 remains gated on compatible successful R01 evidence.

## Completion

The fixed product profile and focused tests demonstrate the gateway runtime shape, exact ephemeral environment handoff, absence of `OPENAI_API_KEY`, unchanged authorized-PR semantics, and credential-free reconnection. Current governing/integration documentation and prospective P5 authority agree on that profile.

Completion does not claim CLIProxyAPI task quality, a successful native PR boundary, or P5 readiness. No P5 provider call, admission, dispatch, PR, disposition, or judgment occurs in this issue.
title: [Integration] Route the fixed V1 DirectTarget profile through the Codex gateway
